text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time for summer camp has arrived
again. For
Mejiro Ryan, it's a time for
both resting and
taking it to the next
level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, her journey from "young woman"
to
"suave lady" continues!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it's already summer again!
I dunno
if I can do this—I stumbled hard
right at the start
last year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How can I become a lady when my
romantic
experience is the same as a
gym newbie who's
hittin' the weights for
the first time?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's all I can think to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you really believe it'll happen for me, I
guess I
can hope everything turns out
okay...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
R-right. I'm not the same person I was
before. I'm
pretty popular now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My muscles are super jacked, and I don't
slip up
during conversations anymore!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But, T-T-Trainer... m-my legs are
t-trembling...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be strong, but her muscles are
wavering.
It feels like the whole cabin is
shaking along with
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe if she can gain some romantic
confidence,
these little earthquakes will
stop too.
